تهرين (form I)
# تَهِرِّينَ (tahirrīna) /ta.hir.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of هَرَّ (harra)
# تُهَرِّينَ (tuharrīna) /tu.har.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
